interpretation.fountain: 3D model represents the 1994 reconstruction. Its inventory point is approximate and the visual model centre is moved about 5 m southwest to avoid overlap with the surveyed mosque footprint. Footprint, tile patterns, basin details and roof dimensions are interpretive.
